catalog.label: Personal and household context
catalog.description: Age, household, employment, education, income, residence and other participant background.

catalog.label: Travel patterns and choices
catalog.description: Trip purpose, timing, frequency, destinations, companions, mode choice and multimodal behaviour.

catalog.label: Walking and wheeling
catalog.description: Walking, wheelchair or mobility-aid travel and pedestrian route conditions.

catalog.label: Cycling and micromobility
catalog.description: Bicycle, e-bike and e-scooter use, facilities, barriers and parking.

catalog.label: Driving and motorcycling
catalog.description: Car and motorcycle use, parking, licensing, costs and driving conditions.

catalog.label: Public transport
catalog.description: Bus, tram, rail, metro, stops, service reliability and transfers.

catalog.label: Shared transport and taxis
catalog.description: Taxi, ride sharing and shared vehicles, including service preferences.

catalog.label: Digital travel tools
catalog.description: Navigation, ticketing, mobility applications, tracking and digital privacy preferences.

catalog.label: Accessibility and navigation
catalog.description: Access, independent movement, crossings, wayfinding, steps, lifts, ramps and obstacles.

catalog.label: Traffic safety
catalog.description: Traffic risk, driver behaviour, conflicts, near misses and road safety interventions.

catalog.label: Personal security and inclusion
catalog.description: Crime, harassment, perceived security, social acceptance and security measures.

catalog.label: Health and wellbeing
catalog.description: Physical capacity, fatigue, stress, anxiety, health effects and activity.

catalog.label: Environment and public space
catalog.description: Air, noise, weather, heat, shade, cleanliness, appearance, seating and public-space experience.

catalog.label: Community and service access
catalog.description: Belonging, neighbourhood relationships, services and access to local activities.

catalog.label: Place reporting and improvements
catalog.description: Place descriptions, observations, service data corrections and improvement proposals.
